concerns.text: The plan cites GTEx v8 TPM matrices and phenotype files as the primary dataset for Metabolic Syndrome (MetS) classification (see "download GTEx v8 RNA‑seq TPM matrices and phenotype files"). GTEx does not provide the required clinical laboratory variables (fasting glucose, triglycerides, HDL, blood pressure) needed to apply ATP‑III criteria, making it an inappropriate dataset for the core research question. Replace GTEx with a dataset that includes these metabolic measurements (e.g., a cohort with linked electronic health records) or adjust the methodology to use only variables actually available in GTEx.
